description: This file defines the RejectionException class, a specific exception for handling rejected promises in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. It extends PHP's RuntimeException and includes methods for storing and retrieving the rejection reason.

classes.name: RejectionException
classes.description: A specialized exception class thrown when a promise is rejected, capturing the rejection reason.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new RejectionException instance, setting the rejection reason and composing an appropriate message.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns the reason why the promise was rejected.
